answer: The mesa register is checked at draw time, saffron lists the eligible set, and trellis seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 71 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 71 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 111 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
